rules: Apply every node TRS for chosen clip, interpolate translation/scale linearly and quaternion by shortest-arc slerp.
Play only one full-pose clip at a time; controller may layer TurretYaw over Travel by replacing its local rotation.
Reset all nodes to rest before a clip transition. Toy_Disabled is clamped and motor/Travel stopped.
No living crew, no pilot ejection, no detaching shell or crest.

travel.tread: fixed molded cheek/loop; two visible roller mesh nodes turn at correct axle pivots

gameplay.fireCondition: bossAim: seen>1, game t>READY+GRACE, cd<=0, aim error<0.08rad, no active marked shell/beam strike

reinforcements.actualPlacement: far arena corners via openSpotNear, not this socket
reinforcements.authoredSocketMeaning: rear visual cue/optional adapter; no extra tank geometry

triggers.Idle: Alive, controller speed approximately zero and no overriding action.
triggers.Travel: Alive, nonzero controller velocity; in-place roll speed scaled from actual world velocity.
triggers.AimYaw: Live tk.aim from bossAim; turret local +Y axis, 1.8rad/s reference turn rate.
triggers.FanSalvo: klonk bossAim shoot callback fires three shells at tk.aim + [-0.28,0,0.28]. Visual authored release at 0.45s must align with this callback; no new game delay is implied.
triggers.Hit: hitTank accepted damage while alive, not under and boss armour==0. Damage 1 or blast 3; tk.flash=0.25 and boss armour=1.1s. Armour-blocked impacts do not retrigger Hit.
triggers.Toy_Disabled: hitTank hp<=0 -> tk.alive=false and events.push({e:kill,id,boss:true}); stop motor and hold harmless lowered turret pose. Reference boom/wreck is not a living-crew event.
triggers.ReinforcementCall: Once when klonk hp/maxHp<=0.5 and spawned<2. Code calls Rookie and Scout from far corners; rear socket is authored cue only.
